prompt: Which of these stay out of the repository? Choose all that apply.
hint: Made by running, arriving from outside, or secret.

choices.text: dbt's target/ directory
choices.why: Right. Made again by every run.

choices.text: The landing files
The price API's key
choices.why: Right. It never enters the directory.

choices.text: The dbt models
choices.why: Those are exactly what belongs in it.

prompt: Why is a secret that never enters the project directory safer than one listed in .gitignore?

choices.text: git encrypts ignored files
dbt refuses projects with ignored files
.gitignore works on Linux machines and not on the others
It cannot be committed by mistake
choices.why: Right. A .gitignore can be edited or bypassed.

prompt: With the new profiles, what does a plain `dbt build` build?

choices.text: Ana's own schemas
Production's schemas
The test warehouse
Nothing until a target is given

prompt: Why is production built from a worktree at a tag rather than from `~/etl`?
hint: What happens when Ana saves a file?

choices.text: dbt cannot read ~/etl
Tags run faster than branches when dbt reads the files
So that edits in progress never reach the nightly
choices.why: Right. Production changes only when the tag does.

choices.text: A worktree needs no database connection of its own to build

prompt: The git command that puts a commit in a directory of its own, beside the working one: `git ___ add`
hint: Two words joined: work and tree.

prompt: What does `--defer` do, given production's manifest as the state?
hint: Where do unselected models come from?

choices.text: Builds every model in dev
Reads every model it does not build from production
choices.why: Right. Ana's mart used production's order views.

choices.text: Delays the build until the nightly runs in production
Writes its models into production's schemas, replacing them

prompt: How many rows of daily_sales were only in dev after the first try?
What did `initcap` do that Ana had not meant?

choices.text: Lower-cased whole categories, so that Poetry would read as poetry in every report
Removed the spaces between the words of each name
Capitalised every word, renaming five categories
choices.why: Right. Science fiction became Science Fiction.

choices.text: Dropped the categories whose names are one word, such as Manga

prompt: Why is zero rows in both directions the right result for the second try?

choices.text: Because the build failed
Because --defer skipped daily_sales
Because dev and prod share one schema, so they have no way to differ
The change protects future data and should not alter today's
choices.why: Right. A refactor that says nothing new today.

A major version

prompt: Which command says which version production is on?

choices.text: git describe --tags
git log --oneline
choices.why: That lists commits on the current branch.

choices.text: dbt debug
git status
choices.why: That shows changes, not the version.

prompt: Order the steps from a finished change to production.
hint: Test, merge, tag, check out, build.
items: Run the test suite on the branch

prompt: A bad version sent a CSV to the managers before it was rolled back. What does the rollback undo?

choices.text: The tables rebuilt from code, not the CSV already sent
choices.why: Right. What was done with the output stays done.

choices.text: Everything, including the CSV
Nothing; a rollback moves git, and not the warehouse's tables
Only fact_sales
choices.why: Views and tables are rebuilt too.

prompt: What part of `fact_sales` does a rollback not reach without a full refresh?

choices.text: The last thirty days
choices.why: Those are replaced on every run.

choices.text: Today
Days older than the thirty-day window
choices.why: Right. The incremental never touches them again.

choices.text: None of it
choices.why: Older days are out of reach.

prompt: Why should code never ask which environment it is in?

choices.text: Python cannot read which target dbt was started with
Production would run code development never ran
choices.why: Right. That is where surprises live.

choices.text: It is slower
dbt forbids conditions on the target inside a model
choices.why: dbt allows it; the reason is the risk.

choices.text: Nothing; prod builds from the ~/etl-prod directory
choices.why: The target does not know where the code came from.

choices.text: It built into dbt_ana
dbt refused, because the branch checked out is not main
Unfinished code was built into the reports' schemas
